alerts.title: Carbamazepine-DTG interaction causing virologic failure
alerts.message: Guidelines state carbamazepine decreases dolutegravir (DTG) levels by 30-70%. The patient started carbamazepine two weeks ago and now has a detectable viral load of 1,240 copies/mL despite reported good adherence. This timing suggests the interaction is the likely cause of treatment failure. The clinician's plan does not address this interaction.

evidence.recommended_action: Switch from carbamazepine to valproic acid per guidelines, or change ART regimen to one not affected by enzyme inducers.

alerts.title: Carbamazepine toxicity with hyponatremia
alerts.message: The patient has symptoms (nystagmus, ataxia, tremor) and a carbamazepine level of 14 mcg/mL, above the therapeutic range (4-12). Concurrent hyponatremia (Na 128 mmol/L) is a known complication of carbamazepine and can exacerbate neurotoxicity. The clinician's plan to reduce the dose and repeat the level is appropriate.

evidence.recommended_action: Implement planned carbamazepine dose reduction, monitor sodium, and assess for symptom resolution.

alerts.title: Elevated ALT requires monitoring
alerts.message: Patient ALT is 68 U/L. Guidelines provide grading for transaminase elevations but do not specify a normal range or action threshold for this value. Both valproate and ART can cause hepatotoxicity. A non-drug cause, such as a concurrent infectious process, should also be considered per guidelines.

evidence.recommended_action: Monitor ALT trend, assess for other causes of liver injury, and consider more frequent testing if symptoms develop.

alerts.title: Viral load failure algorithm not applied
alerts.message: Guidelines state that for a patient with a non-suppressed viral load after six months on ART, a 10-point package should be applied, including engaging a multidisciplinary switch team. The patient's viral load is now detectable at 1,240 copies/mL. The clinician's plan only expresses uncertainty without initiating the guideline-mandated failure workup.

evidence.recommended_action: Apply the 10-point package for non-suppressed viral load, including multidisciplinary review to rule out treatment failure.
